parameters.query: select g.source_id,g.ra,g.dec,g.phot_g_mean_mag,g.ruwe,g.non_single_star,g.ipd_frac_multi_peak,v.in_vari_eclipsing_binary,c.best_class_name,c.best_class_score,e.frequency,e.global_ranking from gaiadr3.gaia_source g left outer join gaiadr3.vari_summary v on g.source_id=v.source_id left outer join gaiadr3.vari_classifier_result c on g.source_id=c.source_id left outer join gaiadr3.vari_eclipsing_binary e on g.source_id=e.source_id where 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',g.ra,g.dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',93.859775,-75.253223,0.0333333333333333)) order by g.phot_g_mean_mag
